name: blueprint/citation-graph
description: Claim trails linked into a queryable graph: extract triples, store nodes and source edges, traverse by prefix scan
ingredients: agent composes cited answers from the graph
recipe: extract claim triples -> store one node per claim and one edge per source -> dedupe claims by text -> compose answers by traversing the trails
pitfalls: the graph is prefix-scan only - a KV index is the documented escalation
the quote stays on every node (citation-trail invariant)
